about.title: Software craftsmanship with deep cross-platform mobile rigor.
about.p1: Based in Alexandria, Egypt, I am a software engineer focused on mobile development. While Flutter is my primary framework for cross-platform delivery, my engineering spans the broader mobile spectrum—including native iOS (Swift), native Android (Kotlin), hardware sensor bridging, and platform-specific performance profiling.
about.p2: Over the past several years, I have architected and deployed high-demand commercial mobile applications across logistics, e-commerce, and FinTech—serving thousands of daily active users with stringent requirements for offline durability, sub-second socket telemetry, and smooth 60 FPS transitions.
about.p3: I lead the Flutter Committee at HackerRank Campus Club, where I mentor aspiring engineers on Clean Architecture, BLoC state management, dependency injection, and test-driven mobile development.
about.p4: My engineering approach is grounded in three principles: strict separation of business logic from UI rendering, bulletproof offline caching with SQLite, and relentless performance profiling.
about.pillar1Desc: Strict boundary isolation between presentation, domain, and data layers. UI widgets remain dumb consumers of immutable state streams.
about.pillar2Desc: Fault-tolerant WebSocket streams, background sync, and offline-first SQLite caching designed for hostile network conditions.
about.pillar3Desc: Bridging native platform channels in Swift and Kotlin for camera sensors, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), background geofencing, and NFC.
